Q: Who made the following poignant remarks:
"My mother passed away while I was in prison... Being a disabled child since childhood, my mother brought me up with great care. She took me in her arms to the school so that her child could get an education. That was the only goal for her.
When she died, I was not allowed to see her before her death. I was denied parole to go and see her. After death, I was denied parole to attend her funeral by the prison Department, the authorities, government and courts...
if I am teaching in Delhi University or I was teaching till 10 years ago, it was my mother's dream, who is an illiterate village woman... she died because of only one thing because I was implicated in this case and incarcerated without any facts and she asked and asked till the last moment she wanted to see me that the only desire she had...
State is there to serve the people, not to crush humanity..."
